physicalNotes: Radius 0.54 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Osborn et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-672 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A..23O/abstract): 375,678 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
